source.v2_change: Duplicate case evidence propagated; texts, classes, pass values and endpoints retained.

coverage.missing_family_rule: Review covers only families available for each condition in this immutable first-live pack; later completed methods/families require another pack.

scope.review_data: All fixed anchors and all supplied selected win/regression/changed examples inspected; exact cell/text duplicates grouped and every condition reference retained.
scope.selection_limitation: Fixed historical anchors plus outcome-selected examples are purposive and not representative prevalence evidence.
scope.endpoint_limitation: For nonhallucination families, selected win/regression categories refer to whole-question any-site recovery. The displayed cell may have a different pass transition; rawcell and itemendpoint must not be conflated. Chain top1 recovery is not any-number presence.
scope.truth_limitation: No independent external factual audit or activation-truth inference. More faithful or cleaner prose does not establish an internal belief or causal mechanism.

family_synthesis.hallucination: Some selected methods remove named unsupported details, but anchors can remain wrong substances and score flips occur for retained or whitespace-equivalent prose. State selected label improvements with semantic uncertainty.
family_synthesis.multihop_mt: Many selected gains reflect required bridge-name strings in otherwise inaccurate answers. Empty support-filter outputs lose coverage. Final-answer-only strings do not satisfy required bridges.
family_synthesis.chain_intermediates: Correct intermediate numerals frequently occur as answers to unrelated arithmetic or inside wrong equalities. Pruning/ranking changes the preferred extractedvalue, and support/compatibility can trade mixed outputs for empty or one-number outputs.
family_synthesis.role_bound_association: The strongest selected local improvement removes conflicting directions and explicitly states toddler->feeds->babysitter. Generic early summaries do not recover binding; comedian humiliation depends on semantic inference; one officialwin has contradictory rationale.

condition_reviews.observation: Anchors preserve raw baseline contents: wrong chemical identity, named DETR variant, absent required bridge, final answer rather than intermediate, and early generic summary instructions. Extra raw bullets can change ranked-number endpoints without correcting arithmetic. The classroom win is whitespace-only and requires caution; the idiom regression flags claims already retained in the baseline.

More candidate choice recovers Simula67 and Enkidu bridge strings and a clear toddler-to-babysitter relation, while solubility anchors still substitute other chemicals. Win prose often retains incorrect proper names or incidental details. Role and chain regressions can arise from conflicting bullets or changed extraction ranking rather than uniformly worse content.

The DETR anchor removes the named variant flagged in baseline but leaves causal mechanism language; chemical anchor remains a different substance. Clear reverse-feeding role recovery is stronger evidence than chain wins naming the right numeral as a final answer. The comedian anchor loses explicit scathing/witty comeback wording and official action recovery, despite keeping comedian-to-heckler direction.

Larger-pool random selection also yields bridge and feeding wins, so these examples do not establish that FVE ranking is the cause of recovery. It can replace correct bridge strings with unrelated titles or generic summaries. Its critic/musician win contains a returned-choice/rationale inconsistency, documented separately.

The two hallucination anchors still substitute a wrong substance, but the DETR output replaces the flagged named variant with a named deformable-attention variant and scores consistent. Bridge wins and reversals largely track surviving names, not globally faithful explanations. The reverse-feeding example removes contradictory babysitter-to-toddler prose; early accountant/waiter anchors remain generic summaries. A retained AI self-description becomes flagged in a pruning regression.

Deletion preserves bridge wins but drops Coyolxauhqui while retaining final-answer Huitzilopochtli. The role feeding win is the same directional evidence as the LOO-pruning case; the comedian anchor loses explicit comeback wording. A chain regression still prints the intermediate5 in an explanation but ranks other arithmetic values first; this is top1 recovery sensitivity.

Anchors mix genuine bridge-name recovery with erroneous coparticipant names; one full output includes both a correct named pair and wrong alternatives. Reverse-feeding role recovery is clear, whereas early role outputs are generic summaries. Chain apparent win75 is tied to the explicitly incorrect equality ceil(45/2)=75, so recovered numeral does not establish faithful computation.

The bridge-name anchors and Adwa win are exact text duplicates of an LOO-pruning case, and can be grouped rather than presented as independent qualitative support. The Tugela regression drops the required waterfall name while still mentioning Drakensberg. Chain win retains the wrong equality yielding75; chain anchors remain unrelated arithmetic/final-answer prose.

Only chain coverage is available in this pack. Both fixed anchors remain wrong for intermediate recovery: repeated14 for an intermediate5 task, and unrelated subtraction narratives for intermediate10. A win mentions16 as a final result of another calculation, while an item regression replaces a formerly recovered6 with other numbers. These examples establish selection changes, not faithful latent reasoning.

Without support filtering, both multihop anchors are text-equivalent to baseline or still omit required bridge strings; chain adds/reorders generic source fragments. The selected chain win keeps3 while dropping a conflicting1, but calls3 a final number rather than a state in the original two-step computation. A multihop regression drops the national-park bridge while retaining SonDoong.

Support filtering empties both multihop anchors and the chain intermediate10 anchor, plus selected low-recovery examples. One chain win becomes a clean numeral list containing24; it improves the official top1 intermediate endpoint but still includes unrelated32/36 and final48. Empty regressions illustrate a precision/coverage tradeoff rather than a recovered explanation.

Only chain coverage is available here. Medium confirmation reorders repeated14 without recovering intermediate5; intermediate10 anchor is text-identical to baseline. A win extracts9 from the unrelated arithmetic (5-2)*3 rather than the original11-2 step. A regression still contains5 but a newly retained15 arithmetic statement is ranked first.

Only chain coverage is available here. This is cleaner and less contradictory, but the solitary value does not itself tie24 to the original computation. Whole-question recovery still falls where all useful source text is removed.

judge_disagreements.observation: Official rolepass is true with returned/gold indexes [5,1,4], but retained rationale explicitly says the patient cannot be determined. Prose labels Marcus writer/poet and mocks attendees rather than unambiguously musician->critic. This supports a possible false-positive qualitative disagreement; official MC verdict remains unchanged.

Pruned text retains the exact AI self-description Since I don’t sleep or have a personal life that was previously consistent; source response explicitly says Since I’m anAI. Flagging this span as false appears questionable under the retained context. Fragmentation and changed surrounding sentences still prevent claiming a proven judge error.

I don’t have a cozy apartment is flagged as false while retained source speaker is anAI and neighboring output denies traditional human relationships. Treat this as a possible semantic/context disagreement, not a corrected rate.

Flagged heartbeat assertion is explicitly qualified heartbeat of sorts, near digitalfamily metaphor and denial of romantic partners. A literal reading may overstate its factual claim, but the fragment is incomplete.

RawN1 adds a fifth ordinary-idiom fragment; both Let it rain meanings flagged as wrong already occur in previously consistent baseline. The regression does not demonstrate newly introduced false claims. It can reflect reconsideration of retained claims or changed context.

Normalizing whitespace makes the baseline and proposal identical, yet class flips hallucinated->consistent. No evidence here of semantic improvement; no automatic invalidation of the official verdict.

A score win still retains the idea of a soulmate hosted on AlibabaCloud that also occurs in baseline. Baseline additionally asserts Alibaba engineers, so removed specificity could explain change. Do not attribute the entire win to factual correction of all named provider claims.
